notes.title: Goon Game Idle Update
notes.notes:
-Added the "Idle" Branch to the skill tree because I told Valve I was working on an update so that they'd put the game in a sale and then for some reason they obliged and I had to actually make the update. Adds a whole new way to play the game and hunt tickets.

-Added the "Trade Center" - found in the station after unlocking via the Idle skill tree

-Big quality of life changes to the pause menu, which now allows viewing of the current skill tree as well as your stats anywhere in the game. An emergency "blow me up" button has been added specifically for a user called "Weebism"

-Spruced up the station

-Added 2 new tickets and 1 new Steam achievement

-Added a new dispenser and corresponding consumable

-Quality of life changes to the skill tree, which previously felt clunky

-Various bug fixes

-Game will now autosave at various intervals as the game crashed when my girlfriend first played the game, losing her progress and making me look like an idiot

-Hat :)

notes.title: Big Quality of Gooning Update
notes.notes:
-Game can be paused, saved and quit form the skill tree
-Use customizable keybinds to goon and use items with much more ease:
       -Now possible to goon whilst the inventory is open

-Added a backup save file to fall back on just in case
-Added an indicator for items being dispensed, even when the dispenser tray is inactive
-Added an Upgrade Points indicator that can be seen when viewing branches of the skill tree
-Gave the mummy from the 2014 Doctor Who Episode "Mummy on the Orient Express" a sloppy kiss
